claim: Northwind moved 85% of its dispatch services to Kubernetes by the end of 2025.
evidence: The engineering blog reports that 85% of dispatch services ran on the new platform by December 2025.

claim: Infrastructure cost per shipment fell from 0.42 to 0.31 US dollars between 2023 and 2025.
evidence: Annual report: infrastructure cost per shipment was 0.42 USD in 2023, 0.37 USD in 2024 and 0.31 USD in 2025.

claim: 61% of surveyed platform teams run production AI inference on Kubernetes.
evidence: Survey of 1,240 organisations: 61% run inference on Kubernetes, 38% run training jobs, 22% use GPU sharing.

claim: Deployment frequency rose roughly fourfold after the migration.
evidence: Derived from 12 deploys per week (2023) versus 49 per week (2025) reported by the company.

claim: Management expects platform savings of about 18 million US dollars by 2027.
evidence: Investor day guidance estimated cumulative savings of 18 million USD by 2027.
